components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--action, hsl(157 42% 21%)); color: var(--action-ink, hsl(46 50% 96%)); height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; font: 600 15px Anuphan, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 1px 1px rgb(4 22 15 / .14), 0 6px 14px -6px rgb(4 22 15 / .4); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .15s ease-out, translate .15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--action-hover, hsl(157 46% 15%)); } .ds-btn-primary:active { translate: 0 1px; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(158 30% 11%); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Mint Button

components.css: .ds-btn-mint { background: hsl(146 46% 71%); color: hsl(158 30% 11%); height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; font: 600 15px Anuphan, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 1px 1px rgb(4 22 15 / .14), 0 6px 14px -6px rgb(4 22 15 / .4); cursor: pointer; transition: filter .15s; } .ds-btn-mint:hover { filter: brightness(1.05); } .ds-btn-mint:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(158 30% 11%); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: White field on paper with ink border on focus and a yellow ring.
components.css: .ds-input { background: #fff; color: hsl(158 30% 11%); height: 44px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid hsl(42 14% 68%); border-radius: 8px; font: 15px Anuphan, sans-serif; outline: none; transition: border-color .15s, box-shadow .15s; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: hsl(156 7% 39%); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: hsl(158 30% 11%); box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px hsl(47 92% 62% / .6); }

components.name: Category Chip
components.description: Filter chip on felt; fills with its card stock when selected.
components.css: .ds-chips { display: flex; gap: 8px; padding: 12px; background: hsl(157 40% 16%); } .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 40px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid hsl(157 26% 31%); border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: hsl(46 50% 95%); font: 600 14px Anuphan, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color .15s; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: hsl(150 22% 79%); } .ds-chip-on { background: hsl(47 92% 62%); color: hsl(158 30% 11%); border-color: transparent; } .ds-swatch { width: 12px; height: 12px; border-radius: 2px; background: hsl(203 72% 75%); }

components.name: Notice
components.description: A found item pinned to the board: card-stock header, photo, stamp, title, place.
components.html:
อิเล็กฯLIB
รอเจ้าของ
iPhone 15 เคสสีม่วงใสห้องสมุด · วันนี้
components.css: .ds-board { background: hsl(157 40% 16%); padding: 24px; } .ds-notice { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; width: 180px; background: hsl(44 50% 97%); color: hsl(158 30% 11%); border-radius: 2px; text-decoration: none; font-family: Anuphan, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 1px 1px rgb(4 22 15 / .14), 0 6px 14px -6px rgb(4 22 15 / .4); transition: translate .2s ease-out, box-shadow .2s; } .ds-notice:hover { translate: 0 -2px; box-shadow: 0 2px 3px rgb(4 22 15 / .16), 0 16px 30px -10px rgb(4 22 15 / .5); } .ds-pin { position: absolute; top: -5px; left: 50%; width: 12px; height: 12px; border-radius: 50%; background: hsl(3 72% 48%); transform: translateX(-50%); box-shadow: inset -2px -2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / .22), inset 2px 2px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / .35), 1px 2px 2px rgb(4 22 15 / .45); } .ds-notice-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; background: hsl(203 72% 75%); font-size: 13px; } .ds-notice-photo { position: relative; aspect-ratio: 4/3; background: hsl(203 72% 75% / .35); } .ds-stamp { position: absolute; right: 8px; bottom: 8px; padding: 1px 8px; border: 2px solid currentColor; border-radius: 999px; color: hsl(3 66% 43%); background: hsl(44 50% 97% / .88); font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px; transform: rotate(-7deg); } .ds-notice-body { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; padding: 12px; } .ds-notice-body small { color: hsl(156 10% 29%); font-size: 13px; }

components.name: Status Stamp
components.description: Status as ink stamp: round red waiting, square blue verified, struck grey returned.
components.html: รอเจ้าของยืนยันแล้ว รอรับคืนแล้ว
components.css: .ds-stamps { display: flex; gap: 20px; padding: 20px; background: hsl(44 50% 97%); font-family: Anuphan, sans-serif; } .ds-st { display: inline-flex; padding: 2px 10px; border: 2px solid currentColor; font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; transform: rotate(-7deg); animation: ds-press .42s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) both; } .ds-st-wait { color: hsl(3 66% 43%); border-radius: 999px; } .ds-st-ok { color: hsl(222 62% 40%); border-radius: 2px; } .ds-st-done { color: hsl(156 7% 39%); border-radius: 2px; text-decoration: line-through 2px; } @keyframes ds-press { 0% { opacity: 0; transform: rotate(-7deg) scale(1.6); filter: blur(3px); } 60% { opacity: 1; filter: none; } 100% { transform: rotate(-7deg) scale(1); } }

components.name: Header
components.description: Felt header with BU card-stock mark, route-stock active link, scalloped trim.
components.html: BULost & Foundของที่เจอแจ้งของหาย
components.css: .ds-head-bar { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 64px; padding: 0 16px; background: hsl(157 42% 21%); font-family: Anuphan, sans-serif; } .ds-mark { background: hsl(47 92% 62%); color: hsl(158 30% 11%); padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 2px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-name { font: 20px Itim, Anuphan, sans-serif; color: hsl(46 50% 95%); margin-right: 16px; } .ds-link { padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 6px; color: hsl(150 22% 79%); font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color .15s; } .ds-link:hover { background: hsl(157 40% 16%); color: hsl(46 50% 95%); } .ds-link-on { background: hsl(47 92% 62%); color: hsl(158 30% 11%); } .ds-trim { height: 10px; background: hsl(47 92% 62%); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle at 8px 0, #000 8px, transparent 8.5px) 0 0 / 16px 10px repeat-x; mask: radial-gradient(circle at 8px 0, #000 8px, transparent 8.5px) 0 0 / 16px 10px repeat-x; }

narrative.overview:
The whole app is the felt board outside a Thai faculty office. The shell and page ground are dark felt green; everything a person reads sits on paper pinned to it. Found items are notices with a card-stock header, and their status is an ink stamp. Real-world board materials supply type, palette, density and one signature move. Navigation and controls stay standard web controls.

The surface is an Operate surface: an anxious owner searching on a phone, a finder logging an item, a guard at the booth. Expression never hides the task. The board carries colour at page scale (felt shell, card-stock categories, route hues) rather than a grey screen with one accent.
keyCharacteristics: Felt-green ground and header; paper sheets for every reading surface.
Thai card-stock colours mark categories, route sections, and page titles.
Red push-pins on sheets and notices; scalloped yellow board trim under the header.
Status stamps: round red = waiting for owner, square blue = verified, struck grey = returned.
Itim marker voice for page titles only; Anuphan for everything else.

rules.name: The Route Stock Rule
rules.body: Each top-level route owns one card-stock hue at full strength: found items yellow, report lost pink, report found mint, guard panel sky, account sand. Page titles are cut from it and the active nav item wears it.

rules.name: The Two Surfaces Rule
rules.body: Text is either on felt (on-felt tokens, yellow focus ring) or on paper (ink tokens, ink focus ring). The `.paper` class switches the focus colour automatically; never place ink text directly on felt.

rules.name: The Marker Rule
rules.body: Itim is handwriting on the board: page titles, item titles, dialog titles. Never for body, labels, buttons, or numbers.

rules.name: The Pinned Rule
rules.body: A sheet that stands alone on the board carries a pin at its top edge (`.pin`). Sheets nested inside another sheet never get a pin and never get a shadow.

dos: **Do** put every reading surface on paper and keep text on felt in on-felt tokens.
**Do** colour categories and routes with card stock at full strength, with ink text on top.
**Do** carry status with stamp shape and word, never colour alone.
**Do** keep motion to the stamp press, the dialog sheet rising, and hover lifts.
donts: **Don't** use gradients, glass, glow shadows, or gradient text.
**Don't** put a kicker or eyebrow label above a heading; the card-stock title strip carries the section.
**Don't** nest a shadowed card inside a sheet; separate with dashed perforation rules instead.
**Don't** add cork texture, paper grain, or tilted notices; the board lends type, palette, density and the stamp, never a costume.
